description: Reversed Engineering a mod that tried to use igpu opencl compute to improve entity handling, sound calculation

mods.name: Laminar
mods.description: An optimization suite that offloads computationally intensive CPU tasks to the integrated GPU (iGPU) using asynchronous OpenCL 1.2. Features 'Hive' (3D flow-field pathfinding), 'Echo' (3D acoustic occlusion), and 'Aura' (3D Line-of-Sight raymarching).
